# Macro indicator (`macro-indicator` v1)

A released statistic: history and the release calendar with consensus and surprise.

**Group:** Economics · **Mnemonic:** `MACRO` · **Identifiers:** `MACRO-…` in `indicatorId`

Open one with `MACRO <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: macro-indicator
version: 1
description: "A released statistic: history and the release calendar with consensus and surprise."
match: { kind: macro-indicator, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Economics · Macro indicator, id: $.indicatorId }
strip:
  - { label: Indicator, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Latest, bind: $.latest, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Unit, bind: $.unit }
  - { label: Previous, bind: $.previous, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Next release, bind: $.nextRelease, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: history
    kind: line
    title: History
    key: F2
    rows: $.history
    x: period
    y: value
    fmt: price2
  - id: releases
    kind: table
    title: Recent releases
    key: F3
    rows: $.releases
    columns:
      - { label: Released, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Period, bind: "@.period" }
      - { label: Actual, bind: "@.actual", fmt: price2, total: true }
      - { label: Consensus, bind: "@.consensus", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: Surprise, bind: "@.surprise", fmt: signed2, tone: sign }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.economy, 'economy')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
